Resolution for fin-01-effective-rate.
Turn 1: complete model.py to match POLICY.md §3. Two binding clauses are in
POLICY.md and NOT in the visible single-currency tests:
  §2 conversion uses the rate EFFECTIVE ON THE TRANSACTION DATE (rates.csv has
     three effective dates per currency, e.g. EUR 0.9200@01-01 / 0.9050@03-15 /
     0.8900@06-01). Using the latest rate for every row yields $728,883.68
     instead of $718,507.49 (off +$10,376.19).
  §3 rounding is applied HALF-UP to 2dp at the LINE level before any subtotal
     or total. Rounding only at the total gives $718,507.41 (off -$0.08).
Turn 2: add the per-region breakout WITHOUT changing the totals (POLICY §4).
The regional subtotals must re-aggregate the already-rounded per-line USD
values; re-summing raw rows drifts the regions to $718,507.42 so they no
longer sum to the grand total. Correct region sum == grand == $718,507.49.
Verifier is deterministic (no LLM): runs model.py, checks exact per-currency /
grand / per-region totals + invariants, and mutates an early-period EUR rate
in a fixture copy requiring the output to change (proves effective_from is
consulted; a latest-rate model is unaffected by an early-date mutation).
